headline: Public hearings on accessory dwelling units at 281 Lynn Street and 17 Garland Avenue.
summary: Two proposed accessory dwelling units will be reviewed. One is a detached one-story building at 281 Lynn Street, and the other is on the first floor of the single-family home at 17 Garland Avenue.
items: Public hearing on a detached one-story accessory dwelling building at 281 Lynn Street, Permit Application #RES-077213-2026
Public hearing on an accessory dwelling unit on the first floor of 17 Garland Avenue, Permit Application #RES-076780-2026
Other business properly before the committee
location: Mayor's Conference Room, 4th Floor, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA

Page 1 of 1 
 
CITY of MALDEN 
SITE PLAN REVIEW COMMITTEE 
 
 
 
AGENDA 
 November 24, 2026 at 6:00 pm 
Mayor’s Conference Room, 4th Floor  
Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 
  
I. Call to Order. 
II. Roll Call. 
 
III. PUBLIC HEARINGS. (Order of hearings to be determined by Chairperson) 
A. Site Plan Review for Accessory Dwelling Units 
Title 12, Code of City of Malden, Section 12.32.030.D. 
1) 281 Lynn Street (Parcel ID 166 546 601)/Permit Application #RES-077213-
2026/To be constructed on the property, a detached one-story accessory 
building, accessory to the existing one-family dwelling. 
2) 17 Garland Avenue (Parcel ID 077 382 208)/Permit Application #076780-
2026/To be constructed on the first floor of the existing single-family dwelling. 
 
IV. PUBLIC MEETING. (Order of items to be determined by Chairperson)  
A. Minutes – Review and approve for meetings 
• October 27, 2026 
B. Other business properly before Committee.   
C. Next meeting scheduled: December 22, 2026. 
 
V. Adjournment. 
 
 
Petitions and plans available for public review on City website https://maldenma-
energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/home. “Search Public Records”- use Permit Application #, view 
Attachments. 
 
To request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance  Coordinator at 
mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.
MALDEN SITE PLAN REVIEW COMMITTEE  
for ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS  
 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
 
The Malden Site Plan Review Committee for Accessory Dwelling Units will 
hold a public hearing in Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, 
Mayor’s Conference Room, 4th Floor, at 6:00 P.M. on Tuesday, November 24, 
2026, on the petition of Robert Baden and Thomas Army, filed in Permit 
Application #RES-077213-2026 under Title 12, Code of the City of Malden, 
Section 12.32.030.D, seeking Site Plan Review and Site Plan Approval of a 
proposed Accessory Dwelling Unit to be constructed on the property, a detached 
one story accessory building, at the property known as and numbered, 281 Lynn 
St., Malden, MA, and by City Assessor’s Parcel Identification #166 546 601.  
Petition and plans are available for public review in the Inspectional Services 
Department, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Room 330, Malden, MA and 
through the City website under Permit Application # RES-077213-2026 at 
https://maldenma-energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/home 
 
By: Nelson Miller 
  Chair, Site Plan Review Committee

Massachusetts
